fact: Lesotho's Health Minister Sekatle said child registration at hospitals matters because everyone would be in the National Population Database, as the Home Affairs NICR registers births and deaths at St Joseph's Roma and three earlier hospitals.
The Ministry of Home Affairs says its National Identity and Civil Registry (NICR) database is in use, verifying the existence of pensioners for the Ministry of Finance.
From 10 August 2020 the Finance Ministry's automated old-age pension payments in Qacha's Nek rely on Home Affairs verifying pensioners against the NICR database and national ID.
